title: Portal
provenance: verified locally on Apple Silicon (M1 Pro), engine sikarugir-10.0_6, Highball 0.7.13, 2026-08-28
notes: Works at ~96 fps under DXVK with HDR off — and the Portal recipe turns it off for you (one button on the game's page in Highball). Same MoltenVK HDR bug and same fix as Portal 2: without mat_hdr_level 0 map loads die on this engine; with it the opening vault renders flawlessly with a clean device log. Apply the Portal fix after installing, keep the bottle on DXVK.

verified.fps: The recorded 96 does not describe play and should not be quoted for it. Measured 2026-09-10 on an M1 Pro, macOS 26.6.2, quiet machine: 17.4 fps on r2 and 17.7 fps on r1 in the first chamber, 1728x1117, DXVK, GPU 4.0 ms of a 57 ms frame. The two engines are within measurement noise of each other, so the engine is NOT the variable and there is no regression between r1 and r2. In every case the GPU is idle and the process holds 124-188% CPU, so Source games are CPU-bound here. Five Nights at Freddy's, which is not Source, hit its recorded 60 fps in the same session on the same engine and renderer, so this is not the machine, DXVK or MoltenVK. Where the original figure came from is not established; it was most likely a menu or idle reading, as Portal 2's 96 explicitly was.
